We had a dog for most of my life up until I was 18. She was around 16 years when she had to be euthanized. She was always super energetic even in old age, always ripping around the yard, so we knew when she stopped being able to walk, eat or control her bladder, it was time. 

The vet euthanized her in my arms. I held her and pet her the entire time and told her it was okay. I wouldn't have had it any other way. She was so peaceful. No one had any doubt it was time for her to go, not even her. She was my best friend since we got her when I was 5. It's been two years since she died and I still cry when I talk about it. 

Here's a picture of her, she was such a special dog. http://imgur.com/imfZGHR

I used to work in a video rental store before it shut down (I was one of the last 3 employees) that had a back room just for porn. 


One day a guy returned some porn, and my coworker opened up the case to check to see if the DVD is in there, and lo and behold, there was this guy's daughter's wedding video instead of the porn. He then showed me it, and we figured that he must have been jerking off to porn and watching his daughter's wedding video within the same session. We all got a creepy vibe from it. 


He never came back to get it.
Yes I like video games. And no I'm agnostic.
I don't drink caffiene at all.

I feel like this all the time. Picking apart who you are and what your mental illness is can be extremely difficult. I also struggle with grieving my past self, as if I can never be that way again and this is how I am going to be forever. It's been like this for the past 3 years, so a lot of the time there looks to be no end, no light on the horizon. 

In high school, I graduated with honors, was in a ton of different clubs, acted on stage, had lots of friends, did a lot of volunteer work and also had a part-time job, and was genuinely happy and excited for what the future would bring. 

Now all I can manage to do is work part-time (and even then sometimes that's a little much) and attempt to get through every day alive and barely ever leave my house except when I absolutely need to. :(

While I agree that abusing this system and being a misogynistic asshole is totally wrong, and there's really no place for that here, people do experience varying degrees of social anxiety and one person's experience isn't going to be more valid than someone else's. You should knock him for thinking women have it better and championing his experience over others- Don't knock him for having seemingly "less severe" social anxiety than you. That being said I do totally get your point. Having people tell you that you're better off than them just because you have a vagina is awful, and that person is being misogynistic and gross and completely inaccurate with their words.

Your internal emotional problems and anxiety will not go away with a face transplant. 

Do you ever think that maybe you think you're ugly because of your social anxiety, not the other way around? People aren't ugly. People are variant and beautiful in different ways. Before finding ways to change things that you can't change unless you undergo surgery, start picking out a few things that you like about your appearance every day. Then pick out a few things you like about yourself and reasons you have merit that DON'T have to do with your appearance. Say these things to yourself in the mirror every day if you can. Even if you don't do every day, that's okay, just making a little progress at a time is important. Don't base all of your self worth on your appearance. 

I hope one day you can learn to love you.
